paragraphs.text: The Star Trek Art Series is a series of 54 art cards that can be found in Star Trek Collector Boosters .

The front face of each card is a full art illustration from the set in either landscape or portrait orientation. The card back is mostly blank with some collector information, including the Magic logo, illustration credits, legal text, and collector number . Art Series cards are similar to an artist 's proofs and thus provide room to get an artist's signature or drawing on it. They can be used by players as tokens for copy effects , as proxies , or if it is for a legendary creature it could be a good way to store experience counters , life total, commander tax, etc.

There are no foil art cards. Instead, all of them are treated with a specially developed gloss varnish that brings out the art. The backs are left uncoated. Art cards appear 35% of the time in the 16th slot of Collector Boosters (alternating with tokens ). Five percent of the time, rather than a normal art card, you'll get one with a gold-stamped signature of the artist. Every art card exists in both its normal version and its signature version.

Star Trek features two Scene Boxes with 12 additional art cards. These cards are designed to display the scene while the full Magic cards are being used for play. There are no gold-stamped signature versions of these art cards.
